points.text: M1: power of an atom to attract electrons to itself
M1: $\text{O}$ lower nuclear charge / lower proton number
M2: $\text{O}$ has (one) fewer shell than $\text{S}$ / less shielding
M1: $[\text{Li}]^{+}$ : $\text{Li}$ inside a circle with 2 electrons shown as dots, enclosed in square brackets with $+$ charge outside
M2: $[\text{H}]^{-}$ : $\text{H}$ inside a circle with 2 electrons shown as dots, enclosed in square brackets with $-$ charge outside
M1: $\text{H}$ (cannot undergo second ionisation because it only) has one electron / $\text{H}^{+}$ has no electron
M1: tick for $\text{O=S=O}$ only, $\text{O=C=O}$ left blank
M2: tick for $\text{S=C=O}$ only, $\text{S=C=S}$ left blank
M1: $\text{O=C=O}$ / $\text{S=C=S}$ has no (overall) dipole as linear and bond dipoles cancel / symmetrical
M2: $\text{O=S=O}$ has (overall) dipole as bent / non-linear and bond dipoles do not cancel
M3: $\text{S=C=O}$ has (overall) dipole as $\text{C=O}$ and $\text{C=S}$ bond dipoles are different / do not cancel
